analysis.title: USA: GS Economic Indicators Update
key_insights: The nominal GS US Financial Conditions Index tightened by 35.9bp to 99.53 over the last week, mostly due to lower equity prices.
The real GS US FCI tightened by 38.7bp to 99.32 over the same week.
The FCI component chart since November 16, 2026 shows the largest contribution from log SPX at 35.4bp, with BBB credit spread at 5.1bp and 10-year Treasury at -9.0bp.
GS Q4 GDP tracking forecast stands at +2.4% quarter-over-quarter annualized.
The GS US MAP index of economic surprises declined on net to +0.17.
The preliminary November Current Activity Indicator stands at +3.1%, unchanged from the +3.1% cited for November.

The report also updates trackers for capex, slack, job growth, ISM manufacturing and services surveys, wages, core inflation and social media sentiment, but gives no numeric readings for them in the text.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Tighter conditions driven mainly by lower equity prices, a modest growth headwind.
Real FCI tightened slightly more than nominal.
Data surprises remain slightly positive but declined on net.
Underlying activity is steady with the prior reading.

risk_factors: Further equity declines could keep tightening financial conditions and weigh on the GDP growth impulse.
